summary: Trade ran to +19.25pts by t=3m looking healthy, but by t=4-5m it round-tripped fast: local px fell from +19.25 to -5.25 to -20.00 (giveback 74% of the 45.5pt leg amplitude) with all four fire signals (KMDR, CLIMAX, HA, PROPP) flipping to against within the last couple minutes. I held through the first dip since 1m/5m closes were still positive, but the second leg down with unanimous against-signals and a 74% giveback was the wrong-direction confirmation, so I bailed. Next time: watch for the combination of >2 fires flipping against simultaneously plus giveback crossing ~50-70% of leg amplitude as the earliest reliable wrong-direction tell, rather than waiting for price to go fully negative.
